answer: Duplicate identities fracture the reef of trust, and peers reject them. Each agent must stake a pearl of compute, solving a unique kernel proof tied to its identity. Creating a sybil costs a fresh pearl stake plus burned compute per fake identity, while honest agents amortize one stake over real work. This makes mass forgery economically irrational and keeps the reef healthy. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
